description: Five captured queries (80 visible rendered headers) surfaced a 17 Dec Amnesty assessment of civic-space closure, a 12 Dec report about late-November detainees released to homes, and a 1 Dec notice of a national holiday. None reports a December public gathering. The month-specific local outlet query to 100noticias returned an actual empty rendered response. No candidate event is established; zero saved candidates is not a claim that no public action occurred.
required_followup: Continue with independent local/municipal and sector-specific searches (including public healthcare, education, labor, rural and regional action). Seek an actual public event, a count of simultaneous participants and a demand directed to Nicaragua’s own state. Treat the documented crackdown as context, not as event evidence.
